**Drafted 4.2.0 in [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).** 380 commits, 3 breaking, 1 feature, 9 fixes.

The breaking ones are the story. Expired tokens return `401`, not `403`. Internal error types stopped being re-exported from five modules. The v1 export route is gone. None were labeled breaking.

Three things need you:

1. Five commits say `docs: note the minimum node version` but never name it. CI runs Node 22. Fill in the real floor.
2. I left perf out. Your shape allows three headings only. Four real speedups exist. Say the word and I add a heading.
3. I dated it `2026-08-30`. Last commit is `2026-06-17`.
